CustomField.description: SLDS icon name (e.g. utility:user or standard:account) displayed in the section header when Show Header is checked. Passed as icon-name to the section's form/header component.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: An SLDS icon to show in the header, entered as category:name such as utility:user. Requires Show Header; leave blank for no icon.
CustomField.label: Header Icon
